limits: No exact host publication timestamp was saved. Brackets use between-batch common witnesses and a separately verified logical raw trigger; no interpolation. Nonnegative downstream bounds assume the saved confirmed footprint is downstream of its unique active publication.
Source timestamps precede construction/enqueue. Pre-publication bounds include that unmeasured gap, filtering/algorithm work and waits. They are not pure queue waiting or function CPU/GIL/Qt shares.
Only original optical input/state is verified by the oracle. GUI/inference/SDK callbacks and thread scheduling are not replayed or attributed. Every case and prior failed quality gate remains.
